mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: Rising short-term interest rate surprise in a stable inflation regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the same month are not statistically lower than the prior month's returns (t-test p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.25% in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +0.6% in a month, it signals accelerating inflation expectations that prompt risk-averse investors to sell equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: Elevated inflation surprise in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the next month are not statistically lower than the prior month's (t-test p > 0.05), or ΔCPIAUCSL ≤ 0.6% in all subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly pay growth acceleration in PAYEMS (ΔPAYEMS > +3%) above prior month's pay growth is associated with stronger wage-price expectations, which raises the cost of capital and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Strong labor market momentum in a neutral inflation regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior month's (t-test p > 0.05), or monthly pay growth does not exceed +3% in any subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in both HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their prior month's levels indicates expanding economic demand, which supports equity valuations and yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND RSAFS > previous month
regime_hint: Dual demand indicators in a non-stagflationary environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or either HOUST or RSAFS does not show a monthly increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 2% suggests weakening supply-side momentum, which raises uncertainty and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: Persistent supply contraction during a growth slowdown
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the following month are not statistically lower than prior (t-test p > 0.05), or INDPRO recovers by > 2% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a strengthening labor market, lowering real wage growth and raising discount rates, which tends to depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: Labor market tightening in a low-inflation environment
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior month's (t-test p > 0.05), or UNRATE does not remain below 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent 3-month declining trend in GDPC1 (GDP) suggests a softening macroeconomic cycle, lowering growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 shows a downward trend for 3 consecutive months
regime_hint: Economic momentum weakening in a mature recovery phase
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the next month are not statistically lower than the prior month's (t-test p > 0.05), or GDPC1 trend reverses in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in both HOUST and PAYEMS above their prior month's levels, especially when CPIAUCSL is flat (< +0.2%), indicate robust demand without price pressures, which supports equity valuations and yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous AND PAYEMS > previous AND ΔCPIAUCSL ≤ +0.2%
regime_hint: Demand expansion without accelerating inflation in a neutral cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL rises > +0.2% in the same month.
